sub_parameters.name: ImageData
sub_parameters.description:
The Base64-encoded string of the image. When both this parameter and the URL parameter are specified, the URL parameter takes precedence.
For information about Base64 encoding of files, see [File Base64 processing](~~468191~~).

sub_parameters.name: ImageURL
sub_parameters.description:
The URL of the image to be detected. Each element in the JSON array is an image detection task structure (image table). A maximum of 10 elements are supported, meaning up to 10 images can be detected simultaneously. We recommend that you use OSS links in the China (Shanghai) region. For files stored locally or OSS links in regions other than China (Shanghai), see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).

> The system automatically converts OSS link addresses to internal network addresses before downloading files, so calling this operation does not incur OSS traffic charges.
